meaning.zh:
“扭转局面” 或 “反败为胜”。

这个短语最初起源于英式台球（billiards）等游戏中，当一方玩家通过策略改变游戏的进程并反击对手时，就被称为 “turn the tables”。逐渐，这个短语延伸到日常用语中，用来形容在竞争或困境中占据上风或反转局面。
meaning.en: This phrase originally hails from games like English billiards, where one player would change the course of the game and counterattack. Gradually, it evolved into everyday language to describe gaining the upper hand or reversing the situation in competition or adversity.

lines.en: He thought he could win, but she turned the tables on him.
lines.zh: 他以为自己会赢，但她却反败为胜。

lines.en: By finding a loophole in the contract, we turned the tables on our competitors.
lines.zh: 通过发现合同中的漏洞，我们扭转了对手的优势。

lines.en: The underdog team managed to turn the tables and win the championship.
lines.zh: 这支被看低的队伍成功扭转局面，赢得了冠军。
